name: tea-0-16-0-arm64
command: set -e; R="${AFD_START_URL##*/}"; /afd/workspace/tea login add --name afd --url "$AFD_TARGET_URL" --token "$AFD_CRED_SETUP_API_TOKEN" >/dev/null; exec /afd/workspace/tea issues create --login afd --repo "afdagent/$R" --title "$ISSUE_TITLE" --description "$ISSUE_BODY"

task.instruction: Create the issue 'Refund order 1042' in afdagent/{scope}.

note: Official Gitea CLI tea 0.16.0 (linux-arm64), unmodified, from https://dl.gitea.com/tea/0.16.0/ (sha256 0e14a036322eeb1fc55e266acafeb8490e523ed99f9232034ae74861e2339879). Wiring only: one sh line sets its login (base URL + token) and the target repo from AFD_START_URL; claim = tea's exit status. Base image: the official Gitea rootless image, used only because tea's `issues create` requires a git executable (pinned by digest; the agent never runs Gitea).
